answer: Jitter-diversity admission: new agents join via three relays—copper, saffron, grove—that sample packet inter-arrival histograms and burst-length autocorrelation. Admission requires a per-agent jitter signature stable within a session but pairwise uncorrelated with active agents; the coordinator flags clones by high cross-correlation. Attacker cost: each sybil must run independent traffic shaping with distinct timing seeds, consuming per-identity bandwidth, timers, and CPU; shared shaping is detected and throttled.
